name: Ameya Precision Engineers Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1987, Ameya Precision Ltd manufactures Pump and Valve  Components and Other Engineering 
 Components used in Valve Industry[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
APL, an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer, produces engineering components such as shafts, stems, overlays, precision trim parts, and assemblies. It is also a One Star Export House and collaborates with audited machining subcontractors to manage customer workloads when needed.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 18.9% CAGR over last 5 years
Debtor days have improved from 97.1 to 73.4 days.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 138 days to 106 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
